subject: Metapulse demo — aligning AE/SE + IT on-call windows
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@metapulse.io>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick intro — demo request from Metapulse signup

Hi Alex — congrats on signing up! I'm Jasmine on the SDR team at Redwood Inference. I saw you completed the self-serve sign-up this morning and wanted to connect you with David (AE) and Karthik (SE) to schedule a quick 30-min walkthrough tailored to your infra and security questions.

Can you confirm who from your side should be on the call (product owners, IT/security, any data-residency folks)? Also, what timezone should we prioritize — I saw the signup location shows Singapore.

Proposed windows (all times local SGT):
- Tue 9/14 10:00–10:30
- Tue 9/14 16:00–16:30
- Wed 9/15 08:00–08:30

If those don't work, happy to send an availability poll. Small ask: if IT/security will join, please loop them in on the reply so we can bring the right artifacts (SOC2, data residency notes).

Thanks — Jasmine
SDR, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Rivera <alex@metapulse.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lin <itsec@metapulse.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T09:03:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro — demo request from Metapulse signup

Thanks Jasmine — excited to see Redwood in action. I'll be the product lead on this; looping Sarah from our IT/security team to validate the schedule and ask a few pre-demo questions.

Sarah: our ideal window is the afternoon SGT (around 16:00 SGT), but we have a maintenance blackout on 9/14 15:30–17:00 — so that rules out the 16:00 slot. The morning slot on 9/14 is tough because several of our EMEA folks have late meetings.

Short answers to your note:
- Attendees: Alex Rivera (Product), Sarah Lin (IT Security), Omar Patel (Cloud Ops) — Omar may join if we need network detail.
- Region: Primary Singapore, but we operate across APAC + EMEA.

Also, Sarah flagged she needs SOC2 evidence and a short security checklist before we confirm. Can you point us to those artifacts?

Best,
Alex
Metapulse — Head of Product

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@metapulse.io>, Sarah Lin <itsec@metapulse.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro — demo request from Metapulse signup

Alex / Sarah — thanks for the quick replies and the heads-up on the blackout. I'm David (AE) — happy to run the walkthrough. I'm looping in Karthik (SE) who will address networking and deployment questions.

Sarah — attached is a short security checklist and a pointer to our SOC2 report (redwood-security-checklist.pdf). For your convenience I also dropped a Drive link below. If you need a formal attestation we can provide our SOC2 Type II PDF via secure link.

Alternative slots that avoid the maintenance window and try to span APAC/EMEA overlap: (all SGT)
- Wed 9/15 08:30–09:00 SGT (works for APAC morning / EMEA late afternoon)
- Thu 9/16 07:00–07:30 SGT (earlier APAC window)
- Tue 9/14 18:00–18:30 SGT (after your blackout, if that suits local EMEA folks)

If it helps, here's a one-click scheduling link to my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/david/30min (pick any available slot and the invite will auto-include the bridge).

We'll prepare a short network diagram and walk through a sample VPC peering + restricted KV cache config so Omar can see the low-privilege data path. Karthik — can you bring a quick OPS checklist for firewall/proxy notes?

Attachments: redwood-security-checklist.pdf (summary), SOC2 link in the Drive folder below.

— David
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lin <itsec@metapulse.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex@metapulse.io>
Date: 2027-09-13T02:14:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro — demo request from Metapulse signup

Thanks David. I reviewed the checklist — good start. A couple of notes before we confirm:
1) Our maintenance blackout on 9/14 is company-wide (can't move). 9/16 early window is tight for our APAC operations team.
2) We need a secure link to your SOC2 report (Drive link is fine if it's access-controlled).
3) For the demo, please ensure network diagram includes any public endpoints and ephemeral port ranges; our ops lead (Omar) will want that to pre-authorize firewall rules.

If the 9/15 08:30–09:00 SGT slot is available, that works best for our combined schedules (Alex is OK with that too). Please confirm timezone conversions for my calendar: 08:30 SGT = 01:30 UTC (is that correct?)

Also, can you provide a short-lived service account for a hands-on connection during the demo (read-only, 1-hour TTL)? We won't accept persistent creds.

— Sarah
IT Security Manager, Metapulse

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <itsec@metapulse.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex@metapulse.io>
Date: 2027-09-13T08:46:00+05:30
Subject: Re: Quick intro — demo request from Metapulse signup

Sarah — thanks for the specifics. Confirming we can cover ephemeral access and will NOT require persistent credentials. I'll prepare a read-only service account with a 1-hour TTL and bring a short network diagram showing public endpoints + recommended port ranges.

09/15 08:30 SGT works for me — I'll be on the call with our network engineer (we'll be virtual).

On quoted note: "our maintenance blackout on 9/14 is company-wide" — understood, we'll avoid that.

— Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@metapulse.io>, Sarah Lin <itsec@metapulse.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-14T16:05:00-04:00
Subject: Confirmed: Metapulse intro demo — 2027-09-15 08:30 SGT / 2027-09-14 21:30 BST / 2027-09-14 16:30 EDT

Great — locking this in for 30 minutes. See invite attached (metapulse-demo-calendar.ics). Bridge details are in bridge-details.txt; dial-in + secure WebRTC link included.

Action items before the call:
- Redwood: Karthik to send the short-lived read-only service account credentials (1-hour TTL) 15 minutes before the call; attach the network diagram in chat.
- Metapulse: Omar to pre-authorize firewall rules for the ephemeral port range in the appended diagram.
- Jasmine: please set a 15-min pre-call to run through introductions and success criteria.

Attachments: metapulse-demo-calendar.ics, bridge-details.txt (bridge + passcode), redwood-security-checklist.pdf

Thanks all — looking forward.

— David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
